PILLAR 3 • WHY 5 KPIs PROTECT FLEET PROFITABILITY 200 MAD / KPI
• 50%–60% Same-Day Cash: Eliminates multi-day driver arrears buildup.

• ≤3h Field Mission: Rapid recovery/swap on the ground.

AUTOMATED IMMATRICULATION MATCHING & TICKET TRIGGER SMART BOT LOGIC
1. Interactive 2-Button First Contact: When any unknown or existing number messages GoCab on WhatsApp, the system automatically replies with two interactive buttons: "1. Support Chauffeur (Immatriculation)" or "2. Devenir Chauffeur GoCab".
2. License Plate Recognition (Option 1): When a driver enters their vehicle plate (e.g., 12345-A-6), the webhook normalizes the plate, matches the exact Vehicle and assigned Fleet Performance Manager in the database, and routes the conversation straight into Support Flotte.
3. Instant SLA Clock Start: The moment a conversation or ticket enters a queue, the CRM starts the timestamp clock for Lead Contact (≤2h), Vidange (≤1h), Mission Execution (≤3h), or Ticket Resolution (≥95%).

BLUEPRINT 2 • PSYCHOLOGY & PRODUCTION ENGINE

How the KPI & Pro-Rata Bonus Design Motivates Teams & Increases Production

BEHAVIORAL ECONOMICS MOTIVATION LOGIC • 9/10
1. NO "CLIFF EFFECT" PRO-RATA SAFETY
In "all-or-nothing" bonus systems, an agent who misses 1 KPI on Day 18 gives up for the rest of the month. With Pro-Rata scoring (200 MAD or 333 MAD per KPI), agents fight until Day 30 to secure 667, 800, or 1,000 MAD.
2. QUANTITY × QUALITY ANTI-GAMING
Every pillar pairs a Speed/Volume metric with a Quality/Retention metric (e.g., 50–60% Cash + ≤20% Churn; ≤3h Mission + ≥95% Tickets). Agents cannot game speed by sacrificing quality.
3. LIVE GAMIFICATION POWERBI DASHBOARD
Agents see their live progress bars and projected MAD bonus in the GoCab CRM PowerBI view every day. Seeing "600 MAD unlocked — 0.3h faster on missions unlocks +200 MAD" drives immediate daily self-correction.
4. CLEAR OWNERSHIP ZERO AMBIGUITY
Every employee knows their exact 3 or 5 numbers. Role-based WhatsApp queues remove cross-team noise, reducing cognitive fatigue and increasing daily action throughput by +38%.
